calculate_list_scores.lua_script:
-- 将 item 级别的 flat list 聚合为 list 级别的分数（加法或位置衰减加权求和）
                  -- raw_list: 长度为 list_num*rerank_list_item_size 的 flat list
                  -- 返回长度为 list_num 的 list 级别分数数组（仅对前 rerank_list_true_num 个 list 计算）
                  local function aggregate_to_list_level(raw_list, list_num, true_num)
                    local agg = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      local start_idx = (i - 1) * rerank_list_item_size
                      local s = 0.0
                      if i <= true_num then
                        for j = 1, rerank_list_item_size do
                          local v = raw_list ~= nil and (raw_list[start_idx + j] or 0.0) or 0.0
                          if enable_position_decay == 1 then
                            s = s + v * (1 / (0.3 + j^0.6))
                          else
                            s = s + v
                          end
                        end
                      end
                      agg[i] = s
                    end
                    return agg
                  end

                  -- 序融合（Order-based ES）：在 list_num 个 list 级别分数上做 ES 排名融合
                  -- list_score_weight_pairs: {{list=list_level_scores, weight=w}, ...}
                  -- 返回长度为 list_num 的 es_scores（初始均为 1.0，逐步累乘）
                  local function calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                    local EPS = 1e-9
                    local es_scores = {}
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      es_scores[i] = 1.0
                    end

                    for _, pair in ipairs(list_score_weight_pairs) do
                      local score_list = pair.list
                      local weight = pair.weight

                      -- 构建 (index, score) 对并按 score 降序排序
                      local score_pairs = {}
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        local s = score_list ~= nil and (score_list[i] or 0.0) or 0.0
                        score_pairs[i] = {idx = i, score = s}
                      end
                      table.sort(score_pairs, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)

                      -- 按排名累乘，分数相同时复用上一个 rank
                      local rank = 0
                      for i = 1, #score_pairs do
                        local sp = score_pairs[i]
                        if i == 1 or math.abs(sp.score - score_pairs[i-1].score) > EPS then
                          rank = i
                        end
                        es_scores[sp.idx] = es_scores[sp.idx] * (1.0 / (rank + 10.0)) ^ weight
                      end
                    end

                    return es_scores
                  end

                  local function safe_list_value(raw_list, index)
                    if raw_list == nil then
                      return 0.0
                    end
                    return raw_list[index] or 0.0
                  end

                  local function find_top1_index(scores, list_num, true_num)
                    local valid_num = math.min(math.max(true_num or 0, 0), list_num)
                    if valid_num <= 0 then
                      return 0
                    end
                    local top1_index = 1
                    local top1_score = safe_list_value(scores, 1)
                    for i = 2, valid_num do
                      local score = safe_list_value(scores, i)
                      if score > top1_score then
                        top1_index = i
                        top1_score = score
                      end
                    end
                    return top1_index
                  end

                  function calculate_list_scores()
                    local n = #pvtr
                    if n ~= rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size or n ~= #pltr or n % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                      error("输入列表长度不一致或不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                    end
                    local list_num = n // rerank_list_item_size
                    local true_num = math.min(math.max(rerank_list_true_num or 0, 0), list_num)
                    local original_scores = {}
                    -- 序融合模式：
                    -- Step1: 对每个 pxtr 在 list 内做 item->list 聚合，得到 list 级别分数
                    -- Step2: 在 list 级别做 ES 序融合（weight > 0 才参与）
                    -- Step3: 最终的 list score 就是 es_score（已是 list 级别，无需再累加）
                    if use_order_es == 1 then
                      local list_score_weight_pairs = {}
                      if context_pctr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pctr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pctr_weight} end
                      if context_pwtd_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pwtd, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pwtd_weight} end
                      if context_pltr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pltr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pltr_weight} end
                      if context_pcmtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pcmtr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pcmtr_weight} end
                      if context_pwtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pwtr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pwtr_weight} end
                      if context_plvtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_plvtr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_plvtr_weight} end
                      if context_psvtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_psvtr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_psvtr_weight} end
                      if context_pftr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(context_pftr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=context_pftr_weight} end
                      if pvtr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(pvtr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=pvtr_weight} end
                      if pwtd_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(pwtd, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=pwtd_weight} end
                      if pltr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(pltr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=pltr_weight} end
                      if pctr_weight > 0 then list_score_weight_pairs[#list_score_weight_pairs+1] = {list=aggregate_to_list_level(pctr, list_num, rerank_list_true_num), weight=pctr_weight} end
                      -- expected_* 为 list 维度，不适合通过 aggregate_to_list_level 从 item 聚合，跳过
                      local es_scores = calc_order_es_scores(list_num, list_score_weight_pairs)
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                        original_scores[i] = es_scores[i]
                      end
                    else
                      for i = 1, list_num do
                      local start_idx = (i - 1) * rerank_list_item_size
                      local es_i = 0.0
                      local list_es_i = 0.0
                      local expected_wt_reward = expected_wt_weight * safe_list_value(expected_list_watch_time, i) * 0.1
                      local expected_ltr_reward = expected_ltr_weight * expected_ltr[i]
                      local expected_pctr_reward = expected_pctr_weight * expected_pctr[i]
                      local expected_comment_reward = expected_comment_weight * expected_comment[i] * 100.0
                      local expected_like_reward = expected_like_weight * expected_like[i] * 50.0
                      local expected_follow_reward = expected_follow_weight * expected_follow[i] * 100.0
                      if use_multiply == 1 then
                        local list_multiply_score = 1.0
                        if expected_wt_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + safe_list_value(expected_list_watch_time, i) * 0.1) ^ expected_wt_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_ltr_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_ltr[i]) ^ expected_ltr_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_pctr_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_pctr[i]) ^ expected_pctr_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_like_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_like[i] * 10.0) ^ expected_like_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_follow_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_follow[i] * 20.0) ^ expected_follow_weight)
                        end
                        if expected_comment_weight > 0.0 then
                          list_multiply_score = list_multiply_score * ((1.0 + expected_comment[i] * 20.0) ^ expected_comment_weight)
                        end
                        list_es_i = list_multiply_score
                      else
                        list_es_i = expected_wt_reward + expected_ltr_reward + expected_pctr_reward + expected_comment_reward + expected_like_reward + expected_follow_reward
                      end
                      if i < rerank_list_true_num + 1 then
                        for j = 1, rerank_list_item_size do
                          local context_pwtd_reward = context_pwtd_weight * context_pwtd[start_idx + j]
                          local context_pctr_reward = context_pctr_weight * context_pctr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local context_plvtr_reward = context_plvtr_weight * context_plvtr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local context_psvtr_reward = context_psvtr_weight * (1 - context_psvtr[start_idx + j]) * 10.0
                          local context_pltr_reward = context_pltr_weight * context_pltr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pcmtr_reward = context_pcmtr_weight * context_pcmtr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pwtr_reward = context_pwtr_weight * context_pwtr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local context_pftr_reward = context_pftr_weight * context_pftr[start_idx + j] * 100.0
                          local pvtr_reward = pvtr_weight * pvtr[start_idx + j]
                          local pwtd_reward = pwtd_weight * pwtd[start_idx + j]
                          local pltr_reward = pltr_weight * pltr[start_idx + j] * 10.0
                          local pctr_reward = pctr_weight * pctr[start_idx + j] * 10.0

                          local element_score = 0.0
                          if use_multiply == 1 then
                            -- 乘法公式：只有权重 > 0 的目标才参与乘法，权重作为幂指数
                            -- 底数加 1.0 保证单调性：(1 + reward_base)^weight，避免底数<1时权重越大值越小
                            local multiply_score = 1.0
                            if pvtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pvtr[start_idx + j] * 0.1) ^ pvtr_weight)
                            end
                            if pwtd_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pwtd[start_idx + j] * 0.1) ^ pwtd_weight)
                            end
                            if pltr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pltr[start_idx + j] * 3.0) ^ pltr_weight)
                            end
                            if pctr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + pctr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ pctr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pctr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pctr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pctr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pltr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pltr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pltr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pcmtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pcmtr[start_idx + j] * 2.0) ^ context_pcmtr_weight)
                            end
                            if context_pwtr_weight > 0 then
                              multiply_score = multiply_score * ((1.0 + context_pwtr[start_idx + j] * 4.0) ^ context_pwtr_weight)
                            end
                            element_score = multiply_score
                          else
                            element_score = context_pwtd_reward + context_pctr_reward + context_plvtr_reward + context_psvtr_reward + context_pltr_reward + context_pcmtr_reward + context_pwtr_reward + context_pftr_reward + pvtr_reward + pltr_reward + pctr_reward + pwtd_reward
                          end
                          if enable_position_decay == 1 then
                            es_i = es_i + element_score * (1 / (0.3 + j^0.6))
                          else
                            es_i = es_i + element_score
                          end
                        end
                      end
                        original_scores[i] = es_i + list_es_i
                      end
                    end

                    -- Listwise 融合直接使用模型的原始预测值做线性加权。
                    -- 关闭开关时 final 与 original 完全一致；original 为 0 时也可仅靠 Listwise 分数排序。
                    local expected_list_watch_time_score_deltas = {}
                    local expected_list_effective_vv_score_deltas = {}
                    local expected_list_interaction_score_deltas = {}
                    local listwise_fusion_score_deltas = {}
                    local final_scores = {}
                    local fusion_enabled = (
                      enable_listwise_fusion == true or enable_listwise_fusion == 1
                    )
                    for i = 1, list_num do
                      local watch_time_score_delta = 0.0
                      local effective_vv_score_delta = 0.0
                      local interaction_score_delta = 0.0
                      if fusion_enabled and i <= true_num then
                        watch_time_score_delta =
                          expected_list_watch_time_weight
                          * safe_list_value(expected_list_watch_time, i)
                        effective_vv_score_delta =
                          expected_list_effective_vv_weight
                          * safe_list_value(expected_list_effective_vv, i)
                        interaction_score_delta =
                          expected_list_interaction_weight
                          * safe_list_value(expected_list_interaction, i)
                      end
                      local fusion_score =
                        watch_time_score_delta
                        + effective_vv_score_delta
                        + interaction_score_delta
                      expected_list_watch_time_score_deltas[i] = watch_time_score_delta
                      expected_list_effective_vv_score_deltas[i] = effective_vv_score_delta
                      expected_list_interaction_score_deltas[i] = interaction_score_delta
                      listwise_fusion_score_deltas[i] = fusion_score
                      final_scores[i] = safe_list_value(original_scores, i) + fusion_score
                    end

                    local original_top1_index = find_top1_index(original_scores, list_num, true_num)
                    local final_top1_index = find_top1_index(final_scores, list_num, true_num)
                    local top1_changed = 0
                    if original_top1_index ~= final_top1_index then
                      top1_changed = 1
                    end

                    local watch_time_delta = 0.0
                    local effective_vv_delta = 0.0
                    local interaction_delta = 0.0
                    local consume_length_delta = 0.0
                    if original_top1_index > 0 and final_top1_index > 0 then
                      watch_time_delta =
                        safe_list_value(expected_list_watch_time, final_top1_index)
                        - safe_list_value(expected_list_watch_time, original_top1_index)
                      effective_vv_delta =
                        safe_list_value(expected_list_effective_vv, final_top1_index)
                        - safe_list_value(expected_list_effective_vv, original_top1_index)
                      interaction_delta =
                        safe_list_value(expected_list_interaction, final_top1_index)
                        - safe_list_value(expected_list_interaction, original_top1_index)
                      consume_length_delta =
                        safe_list_value(expected_consume_length, final_top1_index)
                        - safe_list_value(expected_consume_length, original_top1_index)
                    end

                    return original_scores,
                      expected_list_watch_time_score_deltas,
                      expected_list_effective_vv_score_deltas,
                      expected_list_interaction_score_deltas,
                      listwise_fusion_score_deltas,
                      final_scores,
                      original_top1_index,
                      final_top1_index,
                      top1_changed,
                      watch_time_delta,
                      effective_vv_delta,
                      interaction_delta,
                      consume_length_delta
                  end

rerank_list_padding_default_value.lua_script:
function calculate()
                  if rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list == nil or #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list % rerank_list_item_size ~= 0 then
                    error("rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list为空或者长度不能整除 rerank_list_item_size")
                  end
                  local rerank_list_true_num = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list // rerank_list_item_size
                  local padded = {}
                  for i, v in ipairs(rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list) do
                    padded[i] = v
                  end
                  for i = #rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list + 1, rerank_list_item_idx_flat_list_max_size do
                    padded[i] = -1
                  end
                  return padded, rerank_list_true_num
                end
